correlated_results: No grouped companion papers; four distinct studies. Historical references are not daily highlights.
selection_policy: Relevance, scientific substance, significance and incremental contribution; twelve is a ceiling, not a target. Ordered selected list is the final ranking. Secondary neutrino phenomenology and cosmology candidates were screened and ranked lower; they are not claimed full-text reviewed.

second_topic_pass.scope: Independent topic pass over deduplicated titles/abstracts for cosmic rays/UHECRs, acceleration and diffusion, nuclear interactions, neutrinos, p-gamma and cooling, photons/cascades, dark matter, cosmology, BSM and major experimental constraints; included Unicode gamma titles and full review of IC443 before exclusion.

access_gaps.issue: Historical Li & Chen 2012 full-text endpoint failed twice with redirected inaccessible endpoint. Publisher abstract checked; 2010 original diffusion method PDF read. No full-text claim for 2012 paper.

candidate_version_policy: Version histories individually verified for every selected paper. Nonselected title/abstract screening does not imply every version history was opened. Replacements excluded; cross-list-only candidates not promoted without verification.

revision_provenance.action: Initial 19 November edition; four selected studies after full dated screening and five complete primary-paper reviews. No retrospective batch relabeling.
